objective: Replay a bounded collaboration workflow with independent review work scheduled beside implementation.

nodes.title: Freeze task inputs and acceptance evidence
nodes.context: Read the user-approved objective and the current repository evidence.
nodes.scope: Write only the intake evidence for this replay.
nodes.forbidden: Do not alter the upstream repository or launch a replacement session.
nodes.verify: Record the source revision and acceptance checksums.

nodes.title: Inspect task, ACK and callback boundaries
nodes.context: Inspect the existing delivery contract and identify the dispatch boundary.
nodes.forbidden: Do not send cmux input or modify hook configuration.
nodes.verify: Every claim links to a source path and line range.

nodes.title: Review API and session-reuse constraints
nodes.context: Check that every model call remains owned by an existing Claude/Codex CLI session.
nodes.scope: Write a policy review with blocking findings only.
nodes.forbidden: Do not add SDKs, API keys, proxies, or third-party model calls.
nodes.verify: The review contains explicit PASS/FAIL evidence for each policy.

nodes.title: Implement the isolated orchestration adapter
nodes.context: Implement only the upgrade repository's adapter and tests.
nodes.scope: Write code and tests under the upgrade repository.
nodes.forbidden: Do not modify the upstream checkout or deploy anything.
nodes.verify: Run the focused planner tests and report exact counts.

nodes.title: Document the integration and evidence limits
nodes.context: Document how the adapter relates to OmO, codeg and TypeSafe/JEV.
nodes.forbidden: Do not claim a live JEV or third-party API integration.
nodes.verify: Every external claim includes a pinned SHA or URL.

nodes.title: Run offline contract and schedule tests
nodes.context: Run the repository's offline tests and inspect generated artifacts.
nodes.scope: Write test output under the replay artifact root.
nodes.forbidden: Do not run live model calls or touch the upstream repository.
nodes.verify: All tests pass and no forbidden API field is present.

nodes.title: Audit delivery evidence and closeout claims
nodes.context: Review the generated plan, schedule, tests and evidence classification.
nodes.scope: Write a final audit report; do not rewrite source.
nodes.forbidden: Do not call the result a measured live gain without CLI replay evidence.
nodes.verify: The audit separates offline estimate from measured replay.
